Interior Design Management & Client Experience Platform

RailCortex is a dual-mode Cyber-Physical System modernizing railway infrastructure. In Normal Mode, it acts as a Level 4 Digital Twin, using mathematical optimization to predict and prevent cascading delays. During disasters, our custom IoT edge node triggers an autonomous LangGraph AI swarm to route emergency vehicles with zero human latency.
